description: Extract design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, shadows, CSS variables), semantic HTML layouts, and clean CSS into structured files and an LLM design blueprint. Ideal for cloning websites, UI components, and design systems with 100% pixel fidelity.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

format.description: Format preset for extracted styles: 'tailwind' (default, generates tailwind.theme.json), 'vanilla_css' (generates scoped styles), or 'tokens_only' (design tokens only).

hideOverlay.description: Whether to hide Weavetab overlay during capture (default true).

includeAssets.description: Whether to capture inline SVGs and asset references (default true).

name.description: Optional custom name for the saved design folder (e.g. 'resend-hero', 'pricing-section').

outputDir.description: Optional custom directory to write extracted files into. If omitted, uses configured designDir (~/.weavetab/designs/<domain>-<timestamp>/).

selector.description: CSS selector of the container element to extract (default 'main', falls back to 'body').

name: browser_extract_design
